title: Human Handoff Tool
description: Escalate to human staff. Use for allergen uncertainty, distress, tool failures, complaints, refunds, or out-of-scope questions.

description.const: Conversation context (last few messages, customer intent, any relevant data)

usage_cases.allergen_uncertainty: Customer allergy + missing/unclear allergen data for item
usage_cases.customer_distress: Real emotional distress, self-harm intent, suicidal ideation
usage_cases.tool_failure: Tool returns error after 1 retry; agent cannot proceed
usage_cases.complaint: Customer complains about order, service, quality
usage_cases.out_of_scope: Question unrelated to food/ordering (news, coding, medical, legal, etc.)

properties_comment.fire_and_forget: Creates ticket in support queue and routes to next available agent
properties_comment.response_to_customer: On distress: drop persona, share 988 number, brief warmth. On others: 'A staff member will help you shortly.'
properties_comment.sla: Normal: 5-10 min response; High: 2-5 min; Urgent: immediate
